scope: Agent exposure of existing reviewed per-Case tuning permissions and complete default hardware evidence. No new commands, policy/default changes, Case/comparator changes or NPU experiments.

agent_interface.execution: evaluate, runtime/pmu/compiler profiles, fork and final frozen Snapshot use the existing Case-aware path.

hardware_evidence.scope: Exact registered starting implementation and full default configuration only. Nondefault values and modified Candidates require evaluate.

test_runs.scope: Case inventory, stale/missing evidence, workspace/fork, configuration validation, installed adapters, clean/profile transport, frozen final acceptance, basic and CANNBot isolated launchers.
Actual sandboxed CANNBot Pi and Codex main/child Agents read capability JSON and README; fork and all profile modes; no model or NPU calls.
Legacy fake native Pi/Codex transports and prompt assertions with PTOBENCH_SANDBOX=0; filesystem isolation is tested separately above.

legacy_fixture_note: An initial combined suite reported 10 CANNBot failures because old fake Agents read S5_CONTROL, which the production sandbox intentionally removes. No production isolation rule was weakened. The existing namespace-compatible harness passes for both transports, and the two legacy native prompt tests pass outside the sandbox. Initial diagnostics remain in runs/tuning_case_defaults/agent_tuning_tests.log.
